headline: Ben Roberts-Smith Engages In Partnership With Supplements Business
seoTitle: Ben Roberts-Smith Collaborates With Supplements Brand
metaDescription: Australian decorated soldier Ben Roberts-Smith has entered a collaboration with a fitness supplements company known for its controversial branding.
aiSummaryBullets: Ben Roberts-Smith has entered into a professional partnership with the fitness brand Zero Limits.
The supplements company is managed by fitness influencer and podcaster Chris Katelaris.
The business previously offered a pre-workout supplement marketed under the name War Crimes.
aiContextParagraph: Ben Roberts-Smith, recognized as one of Australia’s most decorated living soldiers, has initiated a collaboration with Zero Limits, a company specializing in gym supplements. The firm is co-owned by Chris Katelaris, a fitness coach and podcaster also identified as Big Chocky, who maintains a public profile as a right-wing influencer. The organization recently drew attention for marketing a pre-workout product explicitly branded as War Crimes. This development follows a period of significant public and legal scrutiny regarding the background and professional associations of Roberts-Smith. The partnership marks a notable shift in his public engagements, moving into the fitness and wellness industry alongside figures known for polarizing online commentary. As of now, the extent and specific objectives of this commercial collaboration between the former soldier and the supplements brand remain subject to ongoing public observation.
whyItIsViral: The story has generated notable public search interest due to the intersection of a high-profile military figure and a controversial commercial partnership.

sources.articleTitle: Ben Roberts-Smith collaborates with gym business run by influencer that sold ‘war crimes’ pre-workout supplement
